effect_description_eng:
[On Play] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your Digimon with [Veemon] or [Veedramon] in its name gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and ＜Evade＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may suspend it to prevent that deletion.).
[All Turns] When one of your Digimon with [Veedramon] in its name becomes suspended, by suspending this Tamer, activate 1 of that Digimon's [When Digivolving] effects.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your blue Digimon becomes unsuspended, gain 1 memory.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
